name: create_ticket
description: Create a Mango ticket on behalf of the current user, linked to this agent and this conversation. This tool CHANGES records, so it never runs directly: calling it asks the user to confirm the exact arguments, and it runs only afterwards. Call it once with the final values; do not retry it. It returns the ticket id.

description.description: Optional: what the ticket is about, in Markdown, at most 8000 characters. Never include credentials.

name: update_ticket
description: Change the status or the priority of a Mango ticket the current user may change, or assign it to the current user. This tool CHANGES records: calling it asks the user to confirm, and it runs only afterwards. Call it once; do not retry it.

assign_to_me.description: Optional: true assigns the ticket to the current user.

name: comment_ticket
description: Add a comment to a Mango ticket the current user may comment, on their behalf. This tool CHANGES records: calling it asks the user to confirm, and it runs only afterwards. Call it once; do not retry it.

body.description: The comment, in Markdown, at most 4000 characters. Never include credentials.
